title: Physical and Psychological Health: Navigating Adolescence with Safety (Ages 10-12)
description: A medical/tarbiyah pathway covering physical changes (puberty), school/social pressures, anxiety/depression, healthy habits, and when parents should seek specialized help.

primary_reference.info: دليل الأكاديمية الأمريكية لطب الأطفال (AAP) للبلوغ والصحة النفسية للمراهقين

review_defects.english: and when parents should seek specialized help
review_defects.why: The Arabic describes the pathway as covering the topic of when parents seek help, without prescribing. The English adds 'should', turning it into a recommendation, which slightly shifts the meaning.
